events.what_it_is: A two-day NYFW pop-up where visitors can refresh their look, create content, browse Calzedonia legwear and use on-site beauty, coffee and photo activations.
events.what_is_free: Public access to the pop-up is free. Current event listings advertise complimentary coffee, branded stickers, hairstyle touchups, a photo booth and beauty sampling. Free embroidery is tied to purchase of 20 Denier Hosiery Knee Highs.
events.caveats: Multiple current NYC event sources agree on September 12–13, 12–5 PM at 188 Lafayette Street and describe the activation as public. Complimentary items and services are subject to on-site availability. Embroidery is not free without the qualifying knee-high purchase.
events.practical_notes: Sunday, September 13 from 12–5 PM. No RSVP, approval or paid-ticket requirement is published in the verified current listings.

events.address: Rockaway Beach at Beach 108th St, Queens, NY 11694
events.what_it_is: Creative Time's public artist sandcastle competition, where invited artists build large-scale works on Rockaway Beach before a judging panel awards the winning team.
events.what_is_free: Watching the public beach competition is free. A separate post-event Benefit Bash is ticketed and is not included in the free beach event.
events.caveats: Creative Time's official page confirms Sunday, September 13 from 1–4 PM at Rockaway Beach. Secondary listings offer a free RSVP, but the official page does not establish RSVP as a condition of public beach access. The separate 5–7 PM Benefit Bash is sold separately.
events.practical_notes: Sunday, September 13 from 1–4 PM at the Beach 108th Street shoreline. Treat this as a public walk-in beach event; the optional/free RSVP path is not required by the official source.

occurrences.details: Public NYFW pop-up; complimentary services and items subject to availability.
Free public beach competition; separate Benefit Bash is ticketed.
